This luxurious topical oil blends seamlessly into skin, providing targeted relief exactly where you need it most. The silky formula absorbs quickly while nourishing your skin, making it ideal for full-body massage or spot treatment of sore areas. Whether you're seeking relief from everyday aches or simply want to elevate your self-care routine, this 500mg massage oil combines therapeutic cannabis with skin-loving botanicals for a truly restorative experience.
